data.title: Donate 2% of your tax to us (2016)
data.excerpt: Our civic association Hradiská is applying for 2% of your tax this year. Last year the money paid for information panels at the Slepý vrch hillfort in Orešany, for clearing a hillfort and a barrow cemetery, and above all for an edited volume.
data.metaTitle: Donate 2% of your tax to us (2016)
data.metaDescription: The civic association Hradiská is applying for 2% of your tax. Last year it funded information panels, a cleared hillfort and barrow cemetery, and a book.

children.text: Our civic association Hradiská is applying for 2% of your tax this year. Last year we used it to make information panels at the Slepý vrch hillfort in Orešany, we cleared 1 hillfort and 1 barrow cemetery, we helped archaeologists with their excavations, but above all we published a high-quality edited volume, which was by no means easy financially. This year we will carry on making information panels and will focus more on helping archaeologists with their excavations. That will mean buying various pieces of equipment. If you support us, your money will be invested in a good cause. Thank you!!!
You can download the form for assigning 2% here: 2% form
